title: House panel scrutinizes BCDA’s P1.98-B budget for 2027, questions Pax Silica project

blocks.text: MANILA – Lawmakers questioned the Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA) over its proposed P1.983-billion budget for 2027, including its plans for the US-backed Pax Silica initiative and the development of a 1,620-hectare advanced manufacturing hub in New Clark City.
